From 1b9448b071caa7d10bb2569fabe3020a2c25ae59 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@intel.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2015 11:49:59 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915: quirk backlight present on Macbook 4, 1

Unsurprisingly macbooks have backlights, just the VBT doesn't seem to
know it in this case.

Reported-and-tested-by: Daniel Nicoletti <dantti12@gmail.com>
Bugzilla: https://bugs.freedesktop.org/show_bug.cgi?id=88325
Fixes: c675949ec58c ("drm/i915: do not setup backlight if not available according to VBT")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org # v3.15+
Reviewed-by: Ander Conselvan de Oliveira <conselvan2@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@intel.com>
Link: http://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/1446716999-1796-1-git-send-email-jani.nikula@intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_display.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_display.c
index b0f23692346e..bcf227356f78 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_display.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_display.c
@@ -14707,6 +14707,9 @@ static struct intel_quirk intel_quirks[] = {
 	/* Apple Macbook 2,1 (Core 2 T7400) */
 	{ 0x27a2, 0x8086, 0x7270, quirk_backlight_present },
 
+	/* Apple Macbook 4,1 */
+	{ 0x2a02, 0x106b, 0x00a1, quirk_backlight_present },
+
 	/* Toshiba CB35 Chromebook (Celeron 2955U) */
 	{ 0x0a06, 0x1179, 0x0a88, quirk_backlight_present },
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_display.c`**
   - A new entry has been added to the `intel_quirks` array for the Apple Macbook 4,1 model. This entry specifies that the quirk `quirk_backlight_present` should be applied to this model, indicating that the backlight is present even if the VBT (Video BIOS Table) does not recognize it.

### Relationships

- The modification in `intel_display.c` addresses a specific bug related to the backlight functionality on the Apple Macbook 4,1. This change is part of a broader effort to ensure that backlight settings are correctly applied to devices that may not be properly recognized by the VBT. The patch is linked to a previous fix (c675949ec58c) that prevented backlight setup when it was not available according to the VBT, thus this new entry serves as a quirk to override that behavior for the specified Macbook model.

Here is the commit message:
drm/i915: quirk backlight present on Macbook 4, 1

Unsurprisingly macbooks have backlights, just the VBT doesn't seem to
know it in this case.

Reported-and-tested-by: Daniel Nicoletti <dantti12@gmail.com>
Bugzilla: https://bugs.freedesktop.org/show_bug.cgi?id=88325
Fixes: c675949ec58c ("drm/i915: do not setup backlight if not available according to VBT")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org # v3.15+
Reviewed-by: Ander Conselvan de Oliveira <conselvan2@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@intel.com>
Link: http://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/1446716999-1796-1-git-send-email-jani.nikula@intel.com

Here is the root cause:
The root cause of the bug is that the Video BIOS Table (VBT) does not recognize the presence of the backlight on the Apple Macbook 4,1 model, leading to the incorrect assumption that the backlight is not available. As a result, the system fails to set up the backlight functionality, even though it is physically present on the device.

Reason:
The Video BIOS Table (VBT) does not correctly identify the backlight on the Apple Macbook 4,1, leading to the assumption that the backlight is not available. Consequently, the system skips the setup for backlight functionality, resulting in the bug.
